## Approved provenance

This complete immutable package supersedes `1.0.0`. The native source and the
Light/Dark `editor-dual` and `error-recovery` references use the authoritative
repair evidence. The source file ID and stable board/component IDs are retained.
G10 approval binds this package to reconciliation candidate
`bd238f6acd55c5008b13ce3eae1475b7f38c9b0a` and its fresh validation evidence.

Do not include secrets.

## Deterministic fixtures

Reference screenshots are captured against the reproducible project documents
defined in `specs/reference-fixtures.md` (launcher recent entries, a Manuscript
with Chapter One + Research notes, 4-document Manuscript for export, dated and
named History checkpoints, recently-deleted items, and a crash-recovery
checkpoint). Fixture definitions are reproducible state, not historical
rationale.

## Current coverage

- **Themes:** Light `dc55a0ad-9907-801d-8008-6a1fb40bcf7a`, Dark
  `469ffc7d-964a-806d-8008-6c323f6d3396`, Foundation Default
  `560a7e2f-3e5d-80c5-8008-6b976eddd033`. Semantic parity 55 color + 2 shadow
  roles per theme; `System` resolves at runtime (not a third set). Dark uses
  fully dark manuscript surfaces (APPR-005).
- **Component families:** 81 local component mains (79 unique names) on Page 02,
  incl. shell/Explorer, editor panes/toolbar, Cards, Inspector/comments, search,
  History/Recently Deleted, settings/dialogs, recovery. 72 carry stable names
  (`PM/...`); every component records theme Light/Dark and requirement
  bindings in `component-matrix.csv`.
- **Screens:** 70 production `PM / Screen /` boards across Pages 03–11;
  20 packaged Light/Dark references; 10 baseline fixtures.
- **Flows:** 11 prototype flows on Page 14 (appearance-cycle, comment-thread,
  companion-focus, create-and-write, delete-restore, export-entire-manuscript,
  global-search-replace, history-restore, organize-hierarchy,
  save-failure-retry, spellcheck-dictionary); 3 prototype terminals; 21
  page-local navigations, 0 cross-page, 0 empty.
- **Platforms:** Windows, macOS, Linux from the start; layout 1280×720 →
  2560×1440 reference boards; intentional differences in
  `cross-platform-variants.md`.
- **Fonts/assets:** Source Sans 3 UI family, Source Serif 4 prose-sample, Inter
  compat roles, `sourcesanspro` legacy (normalized), generic monospace
  code-path; 980 exported icon glyphs; no raster fills in production screens
  beyond the reference images.
